name: ivy-digital-garden
description: Ivy 糖果云朵 — 成长档案与家人站点

scripts.viewer:dev: npm run viewer:prepare && npm run viewer:install && npm --prefix viewer run dev
scripts.viewer:build: npm run viewer:prepare && npm run viewer:install && npm --prefix viewer run build
scripts.build:all: npm run viewer:build && npm run build && npm run viewer:sync
scripts.start:all: npm run build:all && npm run preview
scripts.open:all: npm run build:all && vitepress preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 & sleep 2 && open http://127.0.0.1:4173/ && open http://127.0.0.1:4173/viewer/
scripts.check: npm run test && node scripts/validate-content.mjs && npm run build:all
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.open: npm run build && vitepress preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 & sleep 2 && open http://127.0.0.1:4173/
